description: This file contains high-level functions and data structures for interfacing with DataFlash memory chips on an Atmel microcontroller platform. It includes initialization routines, print functions for device info, and read/write/erase operations.

classes.name: AT91S_DATAFLASH_INFO
classes.description: Structure holding detailed information about a DataFlash device, including sizing, page structure, and ID.

classes.name: AT91S_DataFlash
classes.description: Structure representing a DataFlash device instance, including pointers to its descriptor and device properties.

methods.name: int AT91F_DataflashInit(void)
methods.description: Initializes all DataFlash devices based on configuration, probing each device and setting their parameters.

methods.name: void AT91F_DataflashPrintInfo(void)
methods.description: Outputs information about each detected DataFlash device, including type, size, and address.

methods.name: AT91PS_DataFlash AT91F_DataflashSelect(AT91PS_DataFlash pFlash,unsigned int * addr)
methods.description: Selects the appropriate DataFlash device based on the given address by matching logical addresses.

methods.name: int read_dataflash(unsigned long addr,unsigned long size,char * result)
methods.description: Reads data from a specified address in DataFlash memory into a result buffer.

methods.name: int write_dataflash(unsigned long addr_dest,unsigned int addr_src,unsigned int size)
methods.description: Writes data from a source buffer into a specified address in DataFlash memory.

methods.name: int erase_dataflash(unsigned long addr_dest)
methods.description: Erases the entire DataFlash memory starting from a specified address.

ctags.name: read_dataflash
ctags.pattern: /^int read_dataflash(unsigned long addr, unsigned long size, char *result)$/

ctags.name: write_dataflash
ctags.pattern: /^int write_dataflash(unsigned long addr_dest, unsigned int addr_src,$/
ctags.signature: (unsigned long addr_dest,unsigned int addr_src,unsigned int size)
